claims: The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament Elite Eight games are scheduled for Saturday, March 28, and Sunday, March 29.
Yahoo Sports reported No. 9 Iowa vs. No. 3 Illinois at 6:09 p.m. ET on Saturday, March 28.
Yahoo Sports reported No. 2 Purdue vs. No. 1 Arizona at 8:49 p.m. ET on Saturday, March 28.
No. 9 Iowa vs. No. 3 Illinois is on TBS/truTV.
No. 2 Purdue vs. No. 1 Arizona is on TBS/truTV.
CBS Sports reported that additional games will take place on Sunday, March 29 starting at 2:15 p.m. ET on CBS.
The Elite Eight locations are the Toyota Center in Houston, TX, and the SAP Center in San Jose, CA.
